title: First Day
text: Hello everyone! Today was my first day in Uppsala, and it was amazing. Join me for a quick recap of my day, from the hotel breakfast to the lecture at the Uppsala University. I also had an amazing lunch at a local restaurant, and I can’t wait to share my experiences with you all!
